thesis: Achieve is pivoting from clinical to commercial ahead of a June PDUFA, but a mid-review manufacturing-site transfer to Adare and a roughly 8-month cash runway are overhangs the market may take weeks to weigh.
red_flags: 'Limited in what we can say about our interactions with the FDA'; NDA-named manufacturer had a GMP inspection with 2 observations; 'continue to evaluate financing options' signals dilution; cash $36.4M vs $54.9M annual opex.

thesis: eXp reiterated full-year guidance while flagging tightening macro and low second-half visibility, and folded in a NextHome acquisition not yet in guidance -- a mixed setup the market may take weeks to parse.
red_flags: 'Growing uncertainty and tightening macroeconomic environment'; 'less visibility into the second half'; NextHome contribution 'modest' and 'not currently included in our full year guidance'; agent NPS stepped down sequentially.

thesis: Alto exits a turnaround year deleveraging with higher 45Z credits and CO2/export optionality, but the 2026 upside is partly mechanical/regulatory and front-loaded with seasonal and plant-outage headwinds.
red_flags: Q1 'seasonally challenging'; January cold weather curtailed Pekin production; multiple planned 2026 plant outages; on 45Z traceability, 'not all of our bushels are traced.'

thesis: ArcBest is positioning for a truckload-capacity-driven pricing inflection and guides Q2 margins above normal seasonality, but the demand-recovery timing stays uncertain off a weather-hit Q1.
red_flags: 'Timing and pace of a broader recovery remains hard to predict'; demand 'below mid-cycle norms'; fuel surcharge/cost timing lag; Q1 operating ratio deteriorated 140bps YoY.

thesis: Amtech's AI advanced-packaging mix is climbing past 40% with expanding margins on an asset-light model, durable momentum partly masked near-term by silicon-carbide/PR Hoffman weakness.
red_flags: 'Limited visibility due to our short lead times'; SFS success 'masked by weak sales of PR Hoffman'; '2026 will be an investment year for SFS'; interim CFO amid CFO and COO transitions.

thesis: Axsome just won a first-in-class Alzheimer's-agitation approval and raised AUVELITY's peak-sales outlook to at least $8B ahead of a June launch -- a second growth engine the market may take weeks to fully underwrite.
red_flags: None material; SYMBRAVO gross-to-net in the 'high 70% range' expected to stay elevated near-term; net loss widened on launch investment.

thesis: BJ's is compounding traffic-led share gains with a good/better/best menu strategy to revive check and mix, positioning for second-half flow-through the market may take weeks to credit.
red_flags: Q2 flagged as 'peak for commodity inflation'; average check only flat to +0.2%; higher workers' comp costs; growth still 'predominantly traffic.'

thesis: Brady's organic growth inflected to 8%+ on data-center Wire ID and new products while raising full-year EPS guidance, with the Honeywell PSS deal set to add ~$0.80 accretion -- a multi-quarter step-up the market may take weeks to fully price.
red_flags: None material; management candidly flagged ~1-2% of organic growth was Q2-to-Q3 fill-in; PSS sales fell ~2% in CY2025 before returning to ~5% growth in Q1 CY2026.
